name: TFMG Steel
description: TFMG (The Factory Must Grow) is heavy industry on top of Create.

pages.title: TFMG Steel
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Steel is the gate to most of TFMG
- First steel: a **heated mixer**, 1 per iron ingot
- The **blast furnace** gives 2 per raw iron, fed hot air by a Blast Stove
- Pump the Blast Stove's **CO2** out, or it stalls
TFMG (The Factory Must Grow) is heavy industry on top of Create. Steel is the gate to most of it. The main route is a **blast furnace** fed with hot air, cast into ingots in a basin.

pages.title: Blast Stove
pages.text: Makes Hot Air from air plus fuel. It builds up Carbon Dioxide that stalls it, so pump that out to an Exhaust or Smokestack.

pages.title: Blast Furnace
pages.text: Build a cylinder of Fireproof Bricks around the Output with one Hatch for hot air. Reinforcements speed it up. Items go in at the top.

- **Inputs:** [#](2E5AAC)[crushed raw iron](entry://materials/ore_doubling)[#]() (or raw iron) plus a flux, which is [Limesand](item://tfmg:limesand).
- **Outputs:** molten steel, molten slag and furnace gas.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** the Blast Stove burns furnace gas or creosote, so the furnace can feed itself.

pages.title: Coke Oven
pages.text: Cooks coal slowly into Coal Coke, creosote and CO2. Build long rows. Coke is a long-burning fuel and the base of graphite electrodes.

pages.title: Casting Basin
pages.text: Molten steel poured in sets into a Steel Ingot (90 [#](7A3C9A)[mB](entry://glossary/mb)[#]() each). Also casts [#](2E5AAC)[Big Cannons](entry://industry/cannons)[#]() metals.

TFMG's steel is the pack's steel. Alloyed, Create Nuclear and Big Cannons steel recipes now give it, so a [#](2E5AAC)[heated mixer](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() can supply your first steel at 1 per iron ingot.\
\
The blast furnace gives 2 per raw iron.

Old ingots from those mods convert in a crafting grid. See [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]().\
\
Steel then unlocks pipes, tanks, casings and machines. Next: [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A chemical vat with three Graphite Electrodes is a second way to make steel, from crushed raw iron, flux and coke dust, in a large Fireproof Vat. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for exact sizes.
